title: Audit every column and inverse of the new scaled-fusion native maps
body:
The two new rank-five native transports in PR6529 now have separate exact coordinate evidence. For maps 243→127 and 240→127, an interpreter of the actual source recipes agrees with a separate closed chart/convolution calculation on all 1,024 forward columns. The literal inverse agrees with all 1,024 adjoint columns. Every one of 1,048,576 complex positions, including zeros and absolute phases, is compared before hashing.

The source compiler is bound through all nine nested archives of the exact PR6453 export retained by PR6529. Both old interval boundaries and the new direct MOVE events are checked. Each column has 32 nonzero positions. Eight controls reject wrong global phase, rank, direction and an input phase fault that preserves column zero but changes column eight.

This is a focused finite verification result, with the standard tensor-power implication under the literal placement contract. The original Pauli-plus-phase proof was already complete. The source's conditional κ gain remains credited to its authors. This does not take PR6537's scalar-correction scope, rerun the whole caller/price, discharge a framework assumption, establish independent human acceptance or change the selected frontier. Exact linear sign commutation is not an automatic rule for nonlinear rounded implementations.

Evidence: normal/optimized registered CPython 3.12, source-compiler execution with assertions enabled in an isolated child, committed bytes/modes, official 20-file export with eight inputs, read-only Git-free empty-PATH replay and changed-source rejection pass. The optional full-history check was not run in the shallow checkout. Hosted CI is separate.

Reproduce: `python3 -B scripts/research_package.py --package research/scaled-fusion-native-columns`.

Fresh canonical main 7c49fe32c55de02c2c873655c804b16e4c3fef0a, priority 8, selected 6030. The overlap cache covered 487 open PRs and 6,478 Discussion records; live Discussion 5645 and recent PRs were rechecked before submission. [Scoped claim](https://github.com/CrocSwap/integer-mult-bounds/discussions/5645#discussioncomment-19365847).

Prepared by Ali Romman with substantial OpenAI Codex assistance. Credit PR6529, Erwan L./PR6453, Rohan Arun/PR6399, DreamingOfClouds, Cinna Davis, David Arias, Gareth Davidson, Jacob Alan Sussman, zxv, Cao Yifan and the retained native/compiler lineage. PR6479's retained compiler provenance is checked against the actual new source archive. Original notices remain. Fourier convolution, basis equality and tensor lifting are classical. Apache-2.0.
